scope: Simple hand calculations only, not an FEA, load test, safety rating or manufacturing release. Density and modulus assumptions; no welded-joint compliance, torsion, local stress, material creep, preload, misalignment, fatigue or acoustic model.
rear_beam_model: Simply supported 656 mm, E69 GPa, rear beam 30 high x15 wide x1.5 wall; load illustrative, not measured.
input_shaft_model: Simply supported solid 5 mm steel, E200 GPa; 10N illustrative, actual gear force not established.
thin_link_model: Pinned steel strip 2 wide x1.5 thick, E200 GPa, longest eye-centre span. Not an allowable load. Eye cut-outs, initial crookedness, lateral offset and fatigue not included.
